method: Deterministic connected-border grey chroma/luma removal (chroma<19, 105<meanRGB<173), largest component, hole fill, 0.65px feather; 162x500 cells, 4px gutter, 256-colour RGBA palette. Back mirrored and darkened 0.78; first 100px head replaced by crown colour modulation (helmet overrides), removing face. Source generated Imagen likeness sheet supplied by orchestrator; no new image generation.
reproductionScript:
from PIL import Image,ImageFilter,ImageOps
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
src=Path('mvp/_reviews/imagen/r3/people/people-likeness-sheet.png'); out=Path('mvp/assets/people');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
im=Image.open(src).convert('RGB'); atlas=Image.new('RGBA',(1024,1024)); cells=[]
boxes=[(239,16,423,522),(665,10,877,524),(1059,14,1249,518),(229,531,405,995),(665,535,867,1014),(1092,532,1270,1016)]
for i,(name,box) in enumerate(zip(['suit','tradesperson','beach-goer','cyclist','parent-bag','elder'],boxes)):
 crop=im.crop(box); a=np.asarray(crop).astype(float); lum=a.mean(2); chroma=a.max(2)-a.min(2)
 bg=(chroma<19)&(lum>105)&(lum<173)
 # Only remove grey connected to the crop boundary, preserving neutral fabric interiors.
 seed=np.zeros(bg.shape,bool);seed[0]=bg[0];seed[-1]=bg[-1];seed[:,0]=bg[:,0];seed[:,-1]=bg[:,-1]
 bg=ndimage.binary_propagation(seed,mask=bg); mask=ndimage.binary_fill_holes(~bg)
 labels,n=ndimage.label(mask); sizes=np.bincount(labels.ravel());sizes[0]=0;mask=labels==sizes.argmax()
 alpha=Image.fromarray((mask*255).astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.65));crop.putalpha(alpha)
 # Tight crop scaled into inset cells; retain RGB beneath alpha for mipmap edges.
 crop=crop.resize((162,500),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
 back=ImageOps.mirror(crop); b=np.array(back); b[:,:,:3]=(b[:,:,:3]*.78).astype('uint8')
 # Replace the entire head/face band with spatially varying crown colour: no mirrored face.
 crown=np.median(np.asarray(crop)[8:32,60:103,:3].reshape(-1,3),axis=0)
 if name=='tradesperson': crown=np.array([157,146,123])
 if name=='cyclist': crown=np.array([123,129,130])
 for y in range(100):
  b[y,:,:3]=np.clip(crown*(.72+.18*np.cos((np.arange(162)-81)/81))[:,None],0,255)
 back=Image.fromarray(b)
 x=i*170+4
 atlas.paste(crop,(x,6));atlas.paste(back,(x,518))
 cells.append({'id':name,'index':i,'sourceCrop':box,'frontPixels':[x,6,162,500],'backPixels':[x,518,162,500],'frontUV':[x/1024,518/1024,162/1024,500/1024],'backUV':[x/1024,6/1024,162/1024,500/1024]})
# Palette PNG retains feathered alpha and stays below the one MiB budget.
atlas.quantize(colors=256,method=Image.Quantize.FASTOCTREE).save(out/'i4-atlas.png',optimize=True)
meta={'source':str(src),'sourceSHA256':hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'atlasSHA256':hashlib.sha256((out/'i4-atlas.png').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'dimensions':[1024,1024],'bytes':(out/'i4-atlas.png').stat().st_size,'cells':cells,'identityMap':{'coat-bag':4,'suit':0,'cyclist':3,'child-backpack':4,'elder-cane':5,'hi-vis':1,'jogger':3,'summer-dress':2,'swimwear':2},'method':'Deterministic connected-border grey chroma/luma removal (chroma<19, 105<meanRGB<173), largest component, hole fill, 0.65px feather; 162x500 cells, 4px gutter, 256-colour RGBA palette. Back mirrored and darkened 0.78; first 100px head replaced by crown colour modulation (helmet overrides), removing face. Source generated Imagen likeness sheet supplied by orchestrator; no new image generation.','reproductionScript':Path('/tmp/p23-human-photo-r2/build-atlas.py').read_text()}
(out/'i4-atlas.provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n')
print(meta['bytes'])
